extracted.intended_audience: small businesses and research teams preparing NIAID SBIR/STTR (Phase II) grant applications / principal investigators submitting to NIH NIAID
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and assembling a Phase II STTR (NIAID Advanced Technology STTR R41/R42) grant application including SF424 (R&R), PHS-398 research plan, budgets, facilities, human/animal compliance, SBIR/STTR-specific certifications, and supporting attachments (letters, resource sharing, commercialization plan).

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow funding opportunity/application format
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this application demonstrates good grantsmanship, time has passed since the grantee applied. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications. Adhere to the FOA (Funding Opportunity Announcement) instructions and required forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary / Abstract and Project Narrative / Public Health Relevance Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Project Summary/Abstract (Description) and a Project Narrative (Public Health Relevance Statement) describing significance, public health relevance, and concise aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Project Narrative should explicitly state public health impact (e.g., rapid diagnosis need, target populations, biodefense relevance). Attach as required narrative attachments in the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims and Research Strategy (Significance, Innovation, Approach)
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Specific Aims and a Research Strategy structured around Significance, Innovation, and Approach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NIH-style research plan sections are required (Specific Aims; Research Strategy with subsections for Significance, Innovation, Approach). Provide bibliography & references cited and ensure sections are present in the PHS-398 Research Plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects involvement and protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether human subjects are involved; provide IRB status (IRB approval date or pending), Human Subject Assurance Number, and whether the project is exempt from federal regulations (and the exemption number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer 'Are Human Subjects Involved?' and include related attachments (Human Subjects sections: Protection of Human Subjects, Women & Minorities, Children). Provide documentation and justification for exempt status where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial designation
rubrics_metrics.description: Explicitly state whether the project involves a clinical trial (Clinical Trial: Y/N).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a clinical trial is involved, follow FOA-specific clinical trial submission requirements and include required clinical trial sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate animals use and compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used; if yes, provide IACUC review status, IACUC approval date, and Animal Welfare Assurance Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete Vertebrate Animals sections and supply required assurances and documentation if animals are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves Select Agent research and include the Select Agent Research section if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If Select Agents (e.g., B. pseudomallei listed as Tier I Select Agent) are involved, include required compliance documentation and describe containment, approvals, and biosafety arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental impact reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the project has an actual or potential impact (positive or negative) on the environment and explain if yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If there is an environmental impact, indicate whether an exemption was authorized or whether an environmental assessment (EA) or environmental impact statement (EIS) was performed, and attach explanations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Activities outside the United States / international collaborators
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves activities outside the U.S. or partnerships with international collaborators and identify countries and provide optional explanations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate sites, list countries involved (e.g., Australia, Thailand, UK), and provide justification; note funding restrictions (e.g., Non-STTR funds will be used for foreign sites).

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance sites and project/performance site information
rubrics_metrics.description: List all project/performance site locations, primary site organization names, addresses, DUNS numbers, and congressional districts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full contact and site information for each performance site (e.g., InBios International, University of Nevada Reno, Menzies, Mahidol) and indicate whether the applicant is submitting as an individual or organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities and Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe laboratory, office, and other facilities and resources that will support the proposed research (including square footage, dedicated rooms, biosafety levels, core capabilities, and access to additional institutional resources).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide detailed descriptions of facilities supporting the project (examples in the application: BSL-2/BSL-3 suites, dry rooms, tissue culture rooms, vivarium, GLP-capable labs, IT support, sample tracking systems). Explain how facilities enable proposed work and safety/compliance (e.g., BSL-3 commission schedule, CDC certification).

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List and describe equipment available to support the project, including specialized instruments and production machinery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail relevant equipment (e.g., biosafety hoods, centrifuges, -80 freezers, Biacore X100, Biodot dispensing/lamination/cutter systems, ELISA readers, Wave bioreactor, 3D printer) and note biosafety level and security where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person profiles and biographical sketches
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide profiles for Project Director/PI and all Senior/Key Personnel, including biographical sketches and Current & Pending Support attachments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach Biosketches and Current & Pending Support for each listed key person; indicate project role (PD/PI, co-investigator, collaborator) and credentials/degrees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed Research & Related Budgets for each year and cumulative budgets, with a Budget Justification explaining personnel, materials, travel, subawards, shipping, fringe, and overhead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include line-item explanations (examples: travel to collaborators/meetings, materials and supplies such as membranes, cassettes, colloidal gold, ELISA plates, reagents; shipping costs; fringe benefit and overhead rates with justification and source). Attach subaward budgets and justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward budget details and indirect costs
rubrics_metrics.description: For each subaward, provide Materials & Supplies budgets by budget period, travel funds, publication costs, service contracts, and the subawardee's federally negotiated indirect cost rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: UNR indirect cost rate included at 43.5% (on-campus modified total direct costs). Provide justification for fringe benefit rates and explain that actual costs will be charged if different from averages used for budgeting.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR-specific eligibility and certifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Certify at time of award that the organization meets small business eligibility criteria; disclose subcontracts with federal labs, HUBZone status, whether all R&D will be performed in the U.S., and whether equivalent proposals or awards have been submitted/received from other agencies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer SBIR/STTR information questions (e.g., Program Type, SBIR/STTR Type, certify small business status, identify federal lab subcontracts, indicate HUBZone, provide explanation if research will be performed outside the U.S., disclose equivalent proposals/awards).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commercialization Plan (SBIR/STTR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a commercialization plan describing how the product or technology will be commercialized if the project succeeds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include market opportunities, partners, production/manufacturing capacity, regulatory pathway considerations, and potential customers (e.g., DoD, DHS). Attach commercialization plan per FOA requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe plans for dissemination and sharing of research resources, reagents, data, and materials (e.g., mAbs produced, LFIs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State how research results will be presented/published and how monoclonal antibodies will be made available to academic investigators or licensed. Clarify use restrictions (e.g., LFIs provided initially as Research Use Only or For Export Only). Declare if model organisms or GWAS data are being produced (this application: none anticipated).

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support and collaborative commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Include letters of support from collaborators, testing sites, public health agencies, and potential purchasers that confirm roles, provide access to specimens or strain panels, or offer regulatory/FDA assistance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters may commit to providing sample panels (DHS, PHE), testing large preclinical evaluations (Thailand, Australia), assistance with FDA approval processes, or collaborative logistical support. Letters should be specific about resources and roles (e.g., providing 2000 LFIs, offering assay evaluation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance of R&D location and foreign site funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare where research and development will be performed and note whether non-STTR funds will be used for foreign sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly note which components of the work occur at foreign collaborators (e.g., Thailand, Australia, UK) and document funding sources that will support those activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF 424 (R&R) organizational information and authorized representative certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete SF 424 (R&R) face page information: organizational DUNS, EIN/TIN, type of applicant, address, contact person, and include the Authorized Representative's signature certifying statements and required assurances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By signing, the Authorized Representative certifies to the statements contained in the list of certifications and that statements are true, complete, and accurate (US Code, Title 18, Section 1001). Provide required assurances and list any changes (resubmission, renewal, continuation, revision).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection and tracking of specimens and sample management
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe specimen handling, storage, tracking systems, and security for samples (e.g., Freezerworks sample tracking, locked -80°C freezers for select agents).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail sample tracking systems (Freezerworks), restricted access to select agent storage, and procedures for secure transfer of isolates to certified facilities (e.g., transfer to BSL-3 under appropriate containment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosafety and laboratory accreditation/standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe biosafety levels used, certifications (CDC certification, PC2/PC3/BSL-2/BSL-3), accreditation status (e.g., hospital accreditation), and regulatory compliance for handling dangerous organisms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide evidence of facility accreditation (e.g., Royal Darwin Hospital accredited under Australian Council of Health Care Standards), enrollment in Select Agent Programs, and security measures for select agents (locked freezers, authorized personnel lists).

rubrics_metrics.name: Data, IT, and computational resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe IT resources, servers, data backup, and software available to support data collection and analysis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List server security/firewalls, local-area networks, backup procedures, and software used for data analysis (e.g., sequence analysis, ELISA data processing). Indicate compliance with data security and clinical data collection standards (ICH-GCP where noted).

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory and commercialization support commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: Document potential assistance or commitments from government agencies or partners to support regulatory approval or procurement (e.g., DHS offering strain panels and FDA navigation assistance; DoD procurement interest).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters of support should indicate specific regulatory or acquisition assistance offered and any prior or potential procurement commitments (e.g., DTRA, DoD interest, DHS panels).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Bibliography & References Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Bibliography & References Cited section supporting the Research Strategy and background.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach relevant published and unpublished references to justify methods, prior data, and rationale; include reference attachments as required by the PHS-398.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist and PHS 398 specific forms and attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete PHS 398-specific cover page supplement, checklist, and other agency-specific forms and attachments (e.g., resource sharing, human subjects, vertebrate animals, multiple PI leadership plan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all PHS-398 specific items in the TOC are present and properly formatted (e.g., PHS 398 Checklist, Resource Sharing Plan, Multiple PI Leadership Plan).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current HS Code / HESC / New Investigator / Early Stage Investigator flags
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate applicable status flags such as Current HS Code, HESC, New Investigator, Early Stage Investigator, Senior/Key Personnel listings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all status fields as required by the application system; these can affect review or eligibility considerations and must be accurate.
